## `watch`

Open a lazy, bounded location event stream after SUBACK.

```python
async def watch(
    *,
    entity_ids: Collection[UUID] | None = None,
    integrations: Collection[str] | None = None,
    buffer_size: int | None = None,
    delivery: DeliveryPolicy = DeliveryPolicy.LATEST,
) -> EventStream[LocationEvent]
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity_ids | Collection[UUID] \| None | None | Entity UUIDs to observe, or all entities. |
| integrations | Collection[str] \| None | None | Integration names to observe, or all integrations. |
| buffer_size | int \| None | None | Positive local queue size, or the configured default. |
| delivery | DeliveryPolicy | DeliveryPolicy.LATEST | Local behavior when the stream queue is full. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| EventStream[LocationEvent] | A bounded stream of matching typed location events. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AuthorizationError | If the broker rejects a required subscription. |
| ConnectionError | If the MQTT subscription cannot be completed. |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |
| ResourceLimitError | If the requested queue exceeds the configured limit. |
| ValidationError | If an argument cannot form a supported watcher. |

[Source · interfaces/locations.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/locations.py#L78)

## `last_observed`

Return the latest matching location observed by this client.

```python
def last_observed(entity_id: UUID, *, integration: str | None = None) -> Location | None
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity_id | UUID | — | Canonical entity UUID to look up. |
| integration | str \| None | None | Exact integration to match, or any integration. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Location \| None | The latest matching decoded location, or `None` if none was observed. |

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |

## `wait_for_update`

Wait for a future matching MQTT location update.

```python
async def wait_for_update(
    entity_id: UUID,
    *,
    integration: str | None = None,
    timeout: float | None = None,
) -> Location
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity_id | UUID | — | Canonical entity UUID to observe. |
| integration | str \| None | None | Exact integration to match, or any integration. |
| timeout | float \| None | None | Deadline in seconds, or the configured operation timeout when `None`. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Location | The location from the next matching update. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AuthorizationError | If the broker rejects the temporary subscription or the unsubscribe that releases it. |
| ConnectionError | If the MQTT subscription or its release cannot be completed. |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |
| ProtocolError | If the broker returns a malformed UNSUBACK while the temporary subscription is released. |
| TimeoutError | If no matching future update arrives before the deadline. |
| ValidationError | If `timeout` is not finite and positive. |

[Source · interfaces/locations.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/locations.py#L154)

## `publish`

Publish one typed location for a canonical entity UUID.

```python
async def publish(*, entity_id: UUID, location: Location) -> PublicationReceipt
```

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity_id | UUID | — | Canonical UUID of the located entity. |
| location | Location | — | Position and location information to publish. |

### Returns

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| PublicationReceipt | The local MQTT publication receipt. |

### Raises

| Exception | Description |
| --- | --- |
| AuthorizationError | If the broker rejects the publication. |
| ConnectionError | If the MQTT publication cannot be completed. |
| NotReadyError | If the client has not reached readiness. |
| ProtocolError | If the broker returns a malformed or failed PUBACK. |
| ResourceLimitError | If the encoded payload exceeds the byte limit. |
| ValidationError | If the location cannot be encoded for publication. |

[Source · interfaces/locations.py](https://github.com/picogrid/ecn-sdk-python/blob/v0.1.0/src/picogrid_ecn_client/interfaces/locations.py#L237)
